ar: وَ يَا بَارِئُ احْفَظْنَا مِنَ الْخَلْقِ كُلِّهِمْ
tr: Bi faḍlika wa ‘kshif Yā Muṣawwiru karbanā
en: By Your grace, and remove our worries – O Fashioner, protect us from creation, all of it

tr: Wa bi ‘l-ghafri Yā Ghaffāru maḥḥiṣ dhunūbanā
en: With forgiveness, O Forgiver, eradicate our sins – With force O Subduer, vanquish our enemies
blocks.review: In غَفَّارُ and قَهَّارُ the final رُ is printed brown, not blue; <em> covers the whole name.

ar: وَ هَبْ لِيْ أَيَا وَهَّابُ عِلْمًا وَحِكْمَةً
tr: Wa hab lī Ayā Wahhābu `ilman wa ḥikmatan
Wa li ‘r-rizqi Yā Razzāqu wassi` wa jud lanā
en: Provision, O Provider, expand and improve for us – Bestow me, O Bestower, with knowledge and wisdom
And with knowledge illuminate, O All-Knowing, our hearts – With opening, O Opener, expedite with deference
blocks.review: تكَرُّمًا: no fatḥa visible on the initial tāʾ; transcribed as printed. Verifier: confirmed — only the kāf's fatḥa; the stroke over the tāʾ is the kāf's top bar.

tr: Wa Yā Bāsiṭu ‘l-arzāqi basṭan li rizqinā
en: O Extender of Provisions, extend our provision – O Grasper, seize us in the best of states
